title: 敘事時態:把四個過去一起用

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Last night, I was walking home when I saw an old friend.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: We hadn't seen each other for years.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: She had been living abroad and had just moved back.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: I arrived, sat down, and ordered.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: I was reading when the phone rang.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: When I got there, they had left.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: I was tired because I had been working all day.
